sys_embedded_tour_step.content: This setting allows notifications to be sent from the OnPage scheduler custom workflow. It only takes effect when the custom workflow has been selected in On-Call scheduling. This setting does not disable scheduling in OnPage; it only enables scheduling in ServiceNow.
